Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,883.66 up 23.98 points August 07, 2018, 04:45:10 PM EDT By NASDAQ.com News Shutterstock photo
Tuesday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,883.66. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.18 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 1.29 to 1 ratio. There were 1704 advancers and 1322 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 67 stocks reached a 52 week high and 36 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up .32% for the day; a total of 23.66 points. The current value is 7,462.65. DENTSPLY SIRONA Inc. ( XRAY ) had the largest percent change down (-18.65%) while Tesla, Inc. ( TSLA ) had the largest percent change gain rising 10.99%. The Dow Jones index closed up .5% for the day; a total of 126.73 points. The current value is 25,628.91. Apple Inc.
